name: Admin
description: The account behind this deployment's Chatfuel token, for the person who owns it: every workspace and every bot, created, renamed and deleted from inside the app, one bot's details and connected channels, and a health page saying whether the token still works and what this deployment is missing. Where the auth module is installed it also hands a bot to one of the app's own accounts and takes it back. Reached only with a password held next to the token in the server environment — never a Chatfuel identity, so it works whether or not anybody has an account in the app. Opt-in: the wizard writes ADMIN_PASSWORD.

permissions.requiredFor: listing the account's workspaces and bots, and reading one bot's details
